documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, with FY26 revenue from operations reaching INR 18,911 million and EBITDA at INR 1,960 million. The company sustained double-digit growth in adhesives driven by GST rate reductions and discretionary spending recovery, while replacement tyres and industrial polymers faced demand softness. To support future growth, the company plans to commence its polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 of FY27. Management continues to mitigate input cost inflation through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported its Q3 and 9M-FY26 financial results, recording Q3 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million and EBITDA of INR 392 million.

guidance.claim: Management remains focused on achieving profitable, volume-led growth through channel expansion and new innovative product launches.
guidance.quote: Focus remains on profitable, volume-led growth through new innovative product launches & channel expansion

guidance.claim: The company expects raw material pricing pressures to normalize by Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

guidance.claim: Management expects input costs for adhesives to remain stable during Q3 FY26.
guidance.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends

guidance.claim: The company maintains an overall positive outlook for Agri Products supported by favorable monsoon and soil moisture conditions for the Rabi season.
guidance.quote: Overall positive outlook, supported by an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels, which are expected to strengthen sowing activity and rural sentiment in the Rabi season

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives recorded high double-digit revenue growth supported by GST rate reductions and a recovery in discretionary spending.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained high double-digit revenue growth, driven by robust demand supported by GST rate reductions and a recovery in discretionary spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth prospects are supported by stable domestic construction demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Stable domestic construction demand, supporting growth prospects

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown across both domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand across both domestic and global markets

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial polymers, food polymers, and industrial chemicals experienced softness in demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymers, Food polymers and Industrial chemicals faced demand softness

demand_outlook.claim: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth in adhesives despite a slightly softer demand environment in key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in the key markets

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial and food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty while gaining share in other regions.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial and Food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty but gained share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets drove high double-digit revenue growth in Agri Products.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth

demand_outlook.claim: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a demand slowdown globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in both global and Indian markets

demand_outlook.claim: Renovation activity and adoption of modular furniture are driving urban housing growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising renovation activity, increasing adoption of modular furniture driving growth in urban housing

demand_outlook.claim: USA food polymer sales saw a slowdown due to tariff uncertainty, though the company gained market share in other regions.
demand_outlook.quote: Food polymer business experienced a slowdown in the USA due to tariff uncertainty however company gained market share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: The chemical business recorded high double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth due to improved realizations.
demand_outlook.quote: Chemical business recorded high double-digit value growth in Revenue and EBITDA, due better realisations

capex_expansion.claim: The company will start operating its polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: A world-class R&D center at the Samlya facility supports the development of a new range of SBR latex.
capex_expansion.quote: World-class R&D center at the Samlya (Gujarat) plant facilitates the development of new range of SBR latex

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved expanding Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity at the Samlya site in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity addition for Performance Polymers is 30,000 MTPA.
The required investment for the capacity expansion is approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a capex of around Rs 50 crore to expand manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned expansion will be funded mainly via internal accruals and will add 30,000 MTPA capacity to Performance Polymers.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels helped manage supply disruptions and input cost pressures that emerged in March 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026; however, timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels enabled the company to effectively manage short-term supply disruption while managing the margins

margins_costs.claim: The company is mitigating ongoing input cost inflation via calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost inflation persists; mitigating impact through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margins were negatively impacted by higher input costs for specific raw materials and packing materials.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials and packing materials impacted EBIT margins

margins_costs.claim: Adhesives EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs

margins_costs.claim: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins in performance polymers.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance in Agri Products.
margins_costs.quote: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance

margins_costs.claim: Adhesives EBITDA margins remained healthy helped by lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by Lower input cost

margins_costs.claim: Subdued demand impacted margins in the industrial polymer and food polymer businesses.
margins_costs.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

margins_costs.claim: Higher support for phosphorus and sulphur under the approved NBS subsidy is expected to improve fertilizer affordability.
margins_costs.quote: INR 37,952 crore subsidy approved under the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme for Rabi 2025–26, with higher support for phosphorus and sulphur nutrients, likely to further strengthen fertilizer affordability and offtake

orders_capacity.claim: The total capacity for Polymers and Chemicals is 80,000 MTPA.
The total installed capacity for Single Super Phosphate is 400,000 MTPA.
The existing capacity utilization for Polymers and Chemicals stands at approximately 79%.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed capacity expansion will be funded through internal accruals.
The board approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (“The Demerged Company”) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (“The Resulting Company”)

capital_allocation.claim: The share exchange ratio for the Agri Division demerger is set at 1 : 1.

risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymers remained under pressure due to global weakness; focus continues on adding new customers and portfolio expansion

risks_headwinds.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials and packing materials impacted EBIT margins

risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India, the company sustained double-digit revenue growth
